title_zh: PESI 免費直播：轉化父親傷痕——療癒自我價值、界限與關係模式的臨床工具
title_en: PESI free live training transforming father wounds clinical tools
summary_zh: PESI 心理師免費直播系列。2026 年 10 月 30 日線上舉行，主題是處理女性個案的父親傷痕，聚焦自我價值、界限與關係模式的臨床工具。參加免費，頁面未列學分。
summary_en: PESI's free live online training on 30 October 2026, led by Terri Cole: clinical tools for working with women whose father wounds shape self-worth, boundaries and relational patterns. Free to attend; no CE credits listed on the page.
caution: 免費直播屬入門／推廣性質，不等於完整創傷治療訓練；頁面未列 CE 學分。
brief_zh: 講者 Terri Cole；2026 年 10 月 30 日美中時間 11:00–14:00 線上直播（港澳 10 月 31 日 00:00–03:00）
報名後可免費觀看三日重播
對象：心理師等專業人員
參加免費；學分頁面未列
supervision_questions: 處理個案的「父親傷痕」時，如何避免把關係模式過度歸因於單一童年關係？

training.topic: 父親傷痕與女性個案臨床工具

posts.title: Transforming Father Wounds: Clinical Tools for Healing Self-Worth, Boundaries, and Relational Patterns in Women
posts.content: PESI 心理師免費直播系列，2026 年 10 月 30 日線上舉行，主題是處理女性個案的父親傷痕，聚焦自我價值、界限與關係模式的臨床工具。

related.title_zh: 免費網上研討會：用身體工具建立獲得性安全依附
related.title_en: Free Webinar: Creating Earned Secure Attachment with Somatic Tools
related.summary_zh: 這場免費線上工作坊教治療師用身體取向框架，幫助個案把安全依附變成身體經驗。課程不只談理論，會帶體驗式練習。適合處理發展性創傷與不安全依附的臨床工作者。
related.summary_en: Free one-hour virtual workshop (14 Oct 2026, 12–1pm ET) on helping clients move from insight to embodied secure attachment using three body-based techniques; 1 CE hour for several US licences.

training.provider: Phoenix Center for Experiential Trauma Therapy
training.ce_credits: 1 CE Hour for NBCC, PA SW, LPC, LMFT, and Psychologists

related.title_zh: PESI 免費兩日創傷培訓：Kate Truitt 談創傷神經科學與創傷後成長
related.title_en: PESI free 2-day clinical trauma training Kate Truitt neuroscience posttraumatic growth
related.summary_zh: 臨床心理學家 Kate Truitt 主講的 PESI 免費兩日線上培訓，2026 年 11 月 3–4 日美中時間上午 8 時至下午 4 時直播。內容涵蓋發展與依附創傷、PTSD 與複雜性創傷、解離、階段式治療。直播與三日重播免費，CE 學分與 CCTP 證書另收費。
related.summary_en: Clinical psychologist and applied neuroscientist Kate Truitt leads PESI's free two-day online trauma training on 3-4 November 2026 (8am-4pm US Central): developmental and attachment trauma, PTSD and complex trauma, dissociation and phase-based treatment. Live attendance and three-day replay are free; CE credit and the CCTP credential are available for a fee.

training.price: 免費（直播與重播免費；CE 學分與 CCTP 證書另收費）
training.ce_credits: 另收費（頁面原文：available for a fee）

related.title_zh: Pat Ogden 免費錄影講座：感覺動作心理治療談創傷下的復原力
related.title_en: Free Pat Ogden webinar on resilience amid trauma
related.summary_zh: Leading Edge Seminars 與 Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute（SPI）、SensorimotorItalia.it 合作，免費公開 Pat Ogden 與 Rebeca Farca 的錄影講座「Building Resilience in Times of War, Violence & Other Traumatic Events」。內容介紹如何協助長期處於壓力與威脅下的案主，並附講義、給案主用的 PEACE protocol 與給臨床人員的 SPI protocol 可下載。
related.summary_en: Leading Edge Seminars, with the Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute and SensorimotorItalia.it, offers a free recorded webinar by Pat Ogden and Rebeca Farca, 'Building Resilience in Times of War, Violence & Other Traumatic Events'. It shows how to help clients living with long-term stress and threat, with a downloadable handout, a PEACE protocol for clients and an SPI protocol for clinicians.

training.provider: Leading Edge Seminars（與 Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute 合作）
